title: bn254-gt-dlp: (6,2) STNFS, run gate, log phase at 2.5x its modeled expectation: 2^95.857122420

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x with g^x=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64)2^97.156675187 < 2^95.857122420 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5x2.5 (proof.md section 9). H5x2.5: the true expected descent work is at most 2.5 times the modeled 2^95.805191 (so at most 2^97.127120 units) and every other failure term is at most 10 times its modeled value; work and success bounds both rest on it. The attack first draws an independent 64-bit word v and stops as a failure (under one unit) unless v < K = 7494028811344564431, the least K with (K/2^64) x 0.959995 >= 0.39. Both individual logarithms run under one combined hard phase meter of 2^106 units that aborts as failure, an every-run cap distinct from the score, an expectation: the ledger charges that phase at 2^97.127120 (metered work is at most unmetered work). Multiplying the modeled cap loss 0.000854 by 2.5 (Markov under H5x2.5) and the remaining losses 0.003787 by 10 leaves opened-run success at least 1 - 2.5(0.000854) - 10(0.003787) = 0.959995. All preprocessing, failed trials, closed gates, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=multilevel prints MULTILEVEL.md's campaign tables and recomputes their Clopper-Pearson limits and reading rules; part=toy (plan,rkind,side,bits,seed) regenerates one multilevel run from its seed and prints every node; Default also runs these checks and one stored-run replay. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
